C 型是一组光谱分类，常见于较暗、富含碳质物质的样本。这里的灰褐色与坑洼只是代表: C-type is a spectral class often associated with dark, carbon-rich material. The gray-brown color and relief here are representative artwork, not measurements of one asteroid.
S 型常显示硅酸盐矿物的光谱线索，也可含金属。改变照明会改变这块样本的亮暗，不会: S-types often show spectral clues to silicate minerals and can also contain metal. Lighting changes this sample's shading without changing its composition.
M 型常与含金属的解释联系，但不能把每颗 M 型都认作一整块铁。反射光、密度、雷: M-type is often associated with metal-bearing interpretations, but not every M-type is a solid iron body. Reflected light, density, radar and samples provide different clues. No definite interior is depicted here.
谷神星直径约 950 千米，近似圆球，在主小行星带内绕太阳。矮行星还涉及自身重力: Ceres is roughly 950 km across, nearly round and orbiting the Sun in the main belt. Dwarf-planet classification also involves being rounded by self-gravity, not being a satellite and not dominating the orbital neighborhood. Size or color alone is insufficient.
光源移动了，明暗交界也跟着移动。形状和成分没有被光照改变；转到背面再看看。: Moving the light moves the bright–dark boundary. Illumination has not changed the shape or composition. Rotate to the back and compare.
形状与表面是示意；各样本分别适配画面，屏幕大小不能用来比较直径。颜色不能单独鉴定: Shapes and surfaces are illustrative; each sample is fitted independently, so screen sizes cannot compare diameters. Color alone cannot identify composition.
此对照没有暴露冰，模型不产生彗发和彗尾。: This comparison has no exposed ice, so the model produces no coma or tails.
这个远处条件下，模型中的活动很弱或不可见。: Under this distant condition, activity in the model is very weak or invisible.
受热的冰升华，释放气体并带出尘埃；细离子尾背离太阳，尘埃尾弯向经过的路径。: Heated ice sublimes, releasing gas and carrying out dust. The thin ion tail points away from the Sun; the dust tail curves toward the orbital path.

假想轨道：近日点约 0.9 AU，远日点约 5.5 AU；1 AU 约为地日距离: Hypothetical orbit: perihelion about 0.9 AU and aphelion about 5.5 AU; 1 AU is roughly the Earth–Sun distance. Orbital distances share a linear scale; the Sun, nucleus, coma and tails are enlarged separately.
主带位于火星与木星轨道之间。转成侧面看它的厚度；天体之间有大量空处，画面不是一堵: The main belt lies between Mars and Jupiter. Rotate to see its thickness from the side. Most of the space between bodies is empty, rather than a crowded wall of rock.
此镜头以 AU 表示轨道距离；主带代表点选在约 2.1—3.3 AU。点与太阳均: This view uses AU for orbital distances, sampling the main belt around 2.1–3.3 AU. Points and the Sun are enlarged position markers; count, shape and thickness are illustrative.
海王星以外还有许多含冰的小天体。柯伊伯带的主要区域约在 30—50 AU，真实成: Many icy small bodies orbit beyond Neptune. The Kuiper Belt's main region lies around 30–50 AU; real members differ in orbital tilt and elongation.
此镜头比主带镜头拉远了许多；轨道距离仍按线性 AU 绘制。点是代表定位符，不能当: This camera is much farther out than the main-belt camera; orbital distances still use linear AU. Representative points are neither body diameters, actual counts nor a measured position catalogue.
地球定位符进入了加宽的示意碎屑流。亮圈标记大气所在位置；碎片进入大气，才可能出现: Earth's marker has entered the widened illustrative stream. The halo locates the atmosphere. Fragments can make meteors after entering air, not by burning as meteors out in space.
地球定位符还在示意碎屑流外。沿轨道走一走，看看何处会穿过它；并非整圈都会有同样的: Earth's marker is outside the illustrative stream. Move along the orbit to find a crossing; the same meteor activity need not occur all around the orbit.
亮细带沿用上一站假想彗星的轨道；宽度、点大小和地球圈均放大。背景尘埃云只截取内太: The bright stream follows the previous view's hypothetical comet orbit. Its width, point sizes and Earth halo are enlarged. The background dust cloud shows only part of the inner system, not its complete boundary or an actual meteor-shower forecast.
这是一幅推断结构：来自不同方向的长周期彗星，为遥远的球状储库提供线索。奥尔特云没: This is an inferred structure: long-period comets arriving from different directions provide clues to a distant spherical reservoir. The Oort Cloud has not been directly photographed as this panorama.
独立结构示意，与其他镜头没有共同长度比例。奥尔特云可能延伸到距太阳数千至约十万: A separate structural diagram, without a shared length scale with other views. The Oort Cloud may extend from thousands to roughly a hundred thousand AU from the Sun; its extent and these point positions are not precise measurements.

同样绕着太阳走，为什么有的是石块，有的会长出彗尾，还有的散成尘埃？: All orbit the Sun. Why do some remain rocky bodies, some grow comet tails, and others spread as dust?
一块岩石、一团彗发、一片稀薄尘埃，都在绕太阳运动。转动它们，改变条件，找出这些小: A rock, a comet's coma and tenuous dust all travel around the Sun. Rotate them and change conditions to discover how these small members connect.

关掉它作对照：轨道不变，彗发和彗尾会怎样？这是条件实验，不是在给一颗真实彗星作诊: Switch it off for comparison. With the orbit unchanged, what happens to the coma and tails? This tests a condition, rather than diagnosing a real comet.

从石块到尘埃，是同一条线索: Follow the connection from rocks to dust
小行星不都是一整块坚硬石头；有些是松散碎块组成的集合。彗星也不只是一块干净的冰，: Not every asteroid is a solid rock: some are loose collections of rubble. Comets are not clean blocks of ice either, usually containing dust and rock. Collisions produce fragments and comet activity releases dust. Some small fragments entering Earth's atmosphere can make the meteors we see.
但不能把这些名字排成每个天体都会经历的固定顺序。不是每颗小行星都会变成彗星，也不: These names are not a fixed sequence every body follows. Not every asteroid becomes a comet, and not every dust grain reaches Earth. Orbits, material and environment together influence what happens next.
看图时，怎样分清证据和示意？: How can we distinguish evidence from illustration?
小天体的形状、反射光和轨道有望远镜与探测器观测支持。本页的表面坑洼与代表点分布是: Telescope and spacecraft observations support small-body shapes, reflected light and orbits. Surface relief and representative point distributions here are original illustrations, not terrain or position maps from an observation. Colors distinguish samples and tails rather than replacing spectral, density or sampling evidence.
彗星轨道是已知参数的假想二体椭圆，太阳光照按距离平方反比计算。升华响应、喷流和尾: The comet follows a hypothetical two-body ellipse with defined parameters; sunlight uses an inverse-square law. Sublimation response, jets and tail curves are qualitative teaching mappings without heat transfer, solar-wind, dust dynamics, mass loss or actual meteor showers. Scrubbing samples conditions rather than reversing real sublimation. The Oort view is a separate structural illustration, not an observed exterior, with no shared length scale with the other views.
